gbifID.description: Unique global occurrence identifier assigned by GBIF.

datasetKey.description: Globally unique identifier linking each occurrence record to its source dataset.

occurrenceID.description: Unique observation URLs linking to iNaturalist records for each occurrence.

kingdom.description: All records are classified within the plant kingdom.

phylum.description: Taxonomic phylum for all records, consistently Tracheophyta.

class.description: Taxonomic class of the plant, consistently Magnoliopsida for all records.

order.description: Taxonomic order of the species, consistently recorded as Myrtales.

family.description: Family classification for all records, consistently Onagraceae.

genus.description: Genus of the recorded plant species, consistently Oenothera.

species.description: Scientific name of the recorded plant species, consistently Oenothera coronopifolia.

infraspecificEpithet.description: No infraspecific epithet data recorded for any occurrence.

taxonRank.description: Taxonomic rank of each record, consistently classified at species level.

scientificName.description: Taxonomic designation of the recorded plant species, consistently Oenothera coronopifolia Torr. & A.Gray.

verbatimScientificName.description: Scientific name of the recorded species, consistently Oenothera coronopifolia.

verbatimScientificNameAuthorship.description: Scientific name authorship information is unavailable for all records.

countryCode.description: Two‑letter ISO code of the recording country.

locality.description: Locality information is missing for all records.

stateProvince.description: U.S. states where occurrences were recorded.

occurrenceStatus.description: Occurrence status is always recorded as present for each record.

individualCount.description: Individual count of observed organisms, typically numeric, but data missing in this dataset.

publishingOrgKey.description: Uniform identifier for the organization publishing each occurrence record.

decimalLatitude.description: Geographic latitude in decimal degrees for each occurrence record.

coordinateUncertaintyInMeters.description: Spatial uncertainty of occurrence coordinates expressed in meters.

coordinatePrecision.description: Coordinate precision of occurrence locations, typically expressed in meters.

elevation.description: Elevation data missing for all records.

elevationAccuracy.description: Elevation measurement accuracy is unspecified for all records.

depth.description: Depth data is unavailable for all records.

depthAccuracy.description: Depth accuracy measurement is unavailable for all records.

eventDate.description: Observation timestamps ranging from 1995 to 2026, recorded in ISO 8601 format.

day.description: Day of month when the observation was recorded.

month.description: Month of observation, expressed as numeric month (1‑12).

year.description: Year of occurrence, recorded as four‑digit integer

speciesKey.description: Uniform taxonomic identifier for Oenothera coronopifolia occurrences.

basisOfRecord.description: Record source derived from direct human observation of species occurrences.

institutionCode.description: Data source identifier for the observation platform.

collectionCode.description: Uniform collection identifier labeling all records as observations.

catalogNumber.description: Unique numeric identifier assigned to each occurrence record.

recordNumber.description: Record identifier field, currently empty for all entries.

identifiedBy.description: Names of individuals or accounts who recorded each Oenothera coronopifolia occurrence.

dateIdentified.description: Date and time when each occurrence was identified, recorded as precise timestamps.

license.description: Creative Commons license governing data reuse, primarily CC BY‑NC 4.0.

rightsHolder.description: Rights holder names of individuals or organizations contributing occurrence records.

sample_values: Andy Goerdel - Texas Master Naturalist, Good Water Chapter
recordedBy.description: Observer identifiers, including individuals and organizations, who documented each Oenothera coronopifolia occurrence.

typeStatus.description: No data recorded for type status.

lastInterpreted.description: Timestamp of the most recent data interpretation for each occurrence record.

mediaType.description: Media type of the recorded observation, such as still images.

issue.description: Data quality flags indicating coordinate rounding, continent derivation, or missing taxon identifier.
